content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence instead of contract_research_company_owns, and reduced review days to 30. I need to negotiate - I can change at most two fields. 

I want company ownership for practical integration. I could compromise to company_owns_uni_academic_use (company owns, uni keeps academic use rights) - this is better than uni_owns_option_to_licence for us. And I can accept 30 review days to get the better IP position. That's two fields changed from their proposal.
